column1: # reaction    = frames before it notices what you do (0-60). A person takes about 15-20 frames (0.25-0.33 s).
# think_every = in reach with nothing to react to
# The rest are chances out of 100 (0 = never
# aggression  = at each choice in reach
# punish      = the chance it attacks when it sees you recovering from a move
# chain       = at each link of its string
column2: the chance it presses for the next hit (it chains on the first chain frame

column1: # parry       = the chance it answers a strike it sees coming with its 化劲 parry
# perfect     = when it parries
column2: the chance it aims for the perfect part of the window (otherwise the plain block part).

column1: # step        = the chance it quick-steps to the side to slip a strike it didn't parry; also the chance per choice of a quick step forward to close a long gap.
# circle      = at each choice in reach where it doesn't attack
column2: the chance it circles round you instead of standing and waiting.

column1: # rest_below  = below this much stamina it stops attacking and backs off to 250 cm to breathe (it still parries if it can pay).
# guess       = at each choice in your reach where it doesn't attack
column2: the chance it throws its parry on a guess
column3: the way a person predicts a strike
